summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a 6-K on April 22, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary K Enter Holdings purchased 4,767,494 ordinary shares from key shareholders for an aggregate $2,002,347.48 ($0.42 per share). The transaction, originally structured as a contribution and loan of shares, was restructured as a purchase to avoid unfavorable tax treatment. 10% of the purchase price was paid at execution (December 2025), with the remaining 90% due June 30, 2026. This share repurchase reduces public float and returns capital to shareholders. Watching for future share retirements or additional treasury transactions.
